reasons: Admitted on the vendor's own fetched documentation; this application has not run a live key gate against this endpoint.
Subscription (plan) credential: usage is metered against plan quota, not per-token list prices, so models on this row carry no `pricing`.

admission.citation: https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/ — Kimi Code's own docs, retrieved 2026-09-25: the overseas plan's Anthropic-compatible base is `https://api.kimi.ai/coding/` and its OpenAI-compatible base `https://api.kimi.ai/coding/v1` (the China plan uses api.kimi.com); membership API keys are region-bound; billing is the membership subscription.

outputModalities.sourceRef: WINTER DEFAULT: upstream declares no output modality for ANY model, so `text` is Winter's inference for a chat registry, NOT an upstream statement. See PROVENANCE.md.
